title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
title_zh: 扩展 Horizon 而非参数：35B Agent 达到万亿参数级性能
abstract_en: We introduce Agents-A1, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts Agentic Model that reaches trillion-parameter-level performance by scaling the agent horizon. We investigate agent-horizon scaling from two perspectives: scaling long-horizon trajectories and scaling heterogeneous agent abilities. To support this goal, we build a long-horizon knowledge-action infrastructure that connects external knowledge, actions, observations, and verifier outcomes, producing agentic trajectories with an average length of 45K tokens. Based on this, we train Agents-A1 with a three-stage recipe. First, we perform full-domain supervised fine-tuning to align the base model with broad agentic behaviors. Second, we train domain-level teacher models to capture specialized expertise in each domain. Third, we propose a multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation with salient vocabulary alignment to improve knowledge transfer efficiency across different domains, unifying six heterogeneous domains into one deployable student model. Agents-A1 achieves strong and broad performance for long-horizon agent benchmarks. Compared with 1T-parameter model such as Kimi-K2.6 and DeepSeek-V4-pro, Agents-A1 achieves leading results on SEAL-0 (56.4), IFBench (80.6), HiPhO (46.4), FrontierScience-Olympiad (79.0), and MolBench-Bind (56.8), and remains highly competitive on SciCode (44.3), HLE (47.6) and BrowseComp (75.5). We hope this work provides the community with a practical path for scaling the horizon using a 35B agent that can reach or match the performance of 1T models on long-horizon tasks.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Agents-A1，一个 35B Mixture-of-Experts Agentic Model，通过扩展 agent horizon（智能体长程执行跨度）而非单纯增大参数量，达到万亿参数模型级别的表现。作者从两方面研究 agent-horizon scaling：扩展长程轨迹长度，以及扩展异构 agent 能力。为此，团队构建了长程知识-动作基础设施，将外部知识、动作、观察结果与 verifier outcomes 连接起来，生成平均长度达 45K tokens 的 agentic trajectories。训练上，Agents-A1 采用三阶段流程：首先进行全领域 supervised fine-tuning，使基座模型具备广泛 agentic behaviors；其次训练 domain-level teacher models，捕获各领域专门能力；最后提出 multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation，并结合 salient vocabulary alignment，以提升跨领域知识迁移效率，将六个异构领域统一到一个可部署 student model 中。实验显示，Agents-A1 在多项 long-horizon agent benchmarks 上表现强劲：相比 Kimi-K2.6、DeepSeek-V4-pro 等 1T 参数模型，Agents-A1 在 SEAL-0、IFBench、HiPhO、FrontierScience-Olympiad、MolBench-Bind 上取得领先，并在 SciCode、HLE、BrowseComp 上保持竞争力。该工作展示了一条用 35B agent 通过扩展 horizon 匹配 1T 模型长程任务能力的实践路径。
key_points_zh: 核心思想是 scaling the horizon, not the parameters：通过提升 agent 的长程规划、执行和反馈利用能力，让 35B MoE 模型达到万亿参数级表现。
构建 long-horizon knowledge-action infrastructure，将外部知识、动作、观察和 verifier outcomes 串联，生成平均 45K tokens 的长程 agentic trajectories。
提出三阶段训练 recipe：全领域 SFT 对齐通用 agent 行为，训练领域级 teacher models，再用 multi-teacher domain-routed on-policy distillation 统一多领域能力。
引入 salient vocabulary alignment，提升多 teacher、跨领域蒸馏中的知识迁移效率，使六个异构领域能力整合到单一可部署 student model。
Agents-A1 在 SEAL-0、IFBench、HiPhO、FrontierScience-Olympiad、MolBench-Bind 等长程 agent benchmark 上超过或匹敌 Kimi-K2.6、DeepSeek-V4-pro 等 1T 模型。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong fit due to long-horizon agent trajectory infrastructure, verifier outcomes, and a training recipe aimed at scalable agent performance.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作高度契合方向，因为它围绕长程智能体轨迹基础设施、验证器结果和可扩展训练流程展开。
